observations: The checkpoint-inheritance route retained insufficient evidence and remains unauthorized.
CI sharding reduced development feedback time but is not capability evidence.
Recursive context-routing infrastructure passed exact-head CI and merged, while semantic situation-dependent selection remains unmeasured.
fragment.purpose: Select a capability-relevant and decision-changing unit after rejecting unsupported checkpoint observations and completing CI-latency engineering.
unresolved: whether required contextual branches can be selected without eager full-content loading
whether recursive routing materially reduces context under frozen cases
the user-level real-world AGI objective remains unmet

local_learn.observation: The router's deterministic safety properties are now exact-head validated, but its semantic selection usefulness is still unmeasured; a frozen mechanically scored comparison is required before scoped activation.

evidence_needed: freeze at least six held-out situations before observing routing outputs, spanning multi-child selection, useful depth of at least three, shared descendants, and irrelevant branches
bind each case to hidden required-branch labels, forbidden full-content reads, and an eager-loading context-character baseline
expose only child summaries before selection and record every selected branch, materialized digest, depth, and context-character count

mechanically verify required-branch recall, unselected-content isolation, deterministic replay, manifest/content binding, and all existing path, symlink, cycle, node, depth, fan-out, and context budgets
preserve selection failures and ambiguous cases as negative evidence instead of repairing labels after observing results
expected_outputs: a frozen case manifest and mechanically scored per-case routing report
selected and materialized branch traces with exact content-character comparisons against eager loading
ADOPT_FOR_SCOPED_WORK, REJECT_ROUTING, or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with explicit threshold failures
a separate unchanged user-level FAIL verdict and truthful claim boundary
failure_conditions: any required branch is missed or any forbidden branch full content is read
routing output changes across deterministic replay
the selected graph violates integrity or resource budgets
the context reduction threshold is not met
the experiment requires relabeling held-out cases after outputs are known
result.goal: Run a precommitted held-out experiment to determine whether situation-dependent recursive Skill routing can preserve every required contextual branch while materially reducing full-content materialization relative to eager loading, without activating the router globally.

main merge 818d6434854490efd0319818787d7cde7649f23e with exact source/test blob readback
the user-design requirement for recursive situation-dependent Skill-in-Skill routing

result.parent_continuation: After Execute, run Task Evaluate with separate bounded-unit and user-level verdicts, consolidate and learn the routing evidence, then return to Root without treating internal efficiency or selection accuracy as AGI proof.
result.rollback: Keep the merged router as inactive infrastructure, retain the exact negative report, and continue eager or explicitly scoped context loading until a different precommitted experiment supports use.
success_conditions: 100 percent recall of every hidden required branch across the frozen cases
zero full-content reads from forbidden or unselected branches
identical selected/materialized digests on two deterministic replays of every case
at least one successful depth-three-or-greater route and one successful multi-child route
total materialized context characters no greater than 50 percent of the eager baseline without protected-regression failure
